patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors or large-scale abstract pixelated graphics, often featuring asymmetrical compositions.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual anchors against vibrant backgrounds.
A vibrant, high-contrast palette is used for section backgrounds and abstract graphics, frequently pairing a bright color with black or white text.
Sections reveal with distinct, large-scale abstract pixelated background graphics that are either static within their section or subtly animated as the section comes into view.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered reveals for full-bleed sections, where each section introduces a unique, large-scale abstract pixelated graphic as its background or a prominent side element. These graphics can be rendered using canvas for dynamic effects or CSS keyframes for subtle animations.

Design full-width sections with distinct background colors or large-scale abstract pixelated illustrations. Use a bold, high-contrast sans-serif typography for headlines to create strong visual hierarchy against these vibrant backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clear and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards), maintaining a generally sharp aesthetic for larger elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact layout within content cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, abstract, pixelated graphics as a core visual language, integrated dynamically into the background of various sections, sets it apart. These aren't just static illustrations but appear to be animated or dynamically rendered, creating a playful yet sophisticated tech aesthetic.
